title: Top-bar buttons: Inputs, Network and Settings keep their labels and navigation

steps.expect: The top-right Settings gear stays highlighted after a second Up at the top edge; its Settings caption is visible, with Inputs, Network and Profile alongside it
The Network icon is highlighted and the Ethernet caption is visible on the emulator (the TV shows its current network label)
Android's Network and Internet settings are open after selecting the Network button
Inputs is highlighted with the Inputs caption; a second Left stays on Inputs at the left edge of the top bar
The input picker is open, or a message explains that this emulator has no TV inputs; on a TV the connected inputs are listed
Profile is highlighted at the right edge, with the three named top-bar icons to its left
Android's system Settings screen is open after selecting the Settings gear
Focus is back on the Dock after Down from the top bar; the corner controls are no longer highlighted
Settings is highlighted again after a cold start, with all three top-bar icons and Profile present
